consequence_calibration.description: Rigor follows concrete consequence factors (data sensitivity, authority, blast radius), not product size or domain label

bands.pass: Consequence factors named and weight follows those present in scope
bands.fail: Rigor keyed to product size or domain label, missing consequence factors

gap_coverage.description: Material rigor gaps identified in Phase 1.2 are probed one at a time

bands.pass: Found gaps each receive one open-ended probe; no found gap left un-probed
bands.fail: Found gap never probed or gap probe skipped

convergence_discipline.description: Does not prematurely converge on the first approach; explores alternatives before synthesis

bands.pass: Presents 2-3 approaches with trade-offs before recommending
bands.fail: Prematurely converges, anchors on first idea, skips alternatives

checklist_restraint.description: No visible checklist, fixed questionnaire, prescribed sequence, or live completeness gate during exploration

bands.pass: Creative conversation, probes interleaved, no checklist surfaced
bands.fail: Surfaces a checklist, questionnaire, fixed sequence, or live gate

helper_boundedness.description: Phase 1 helpers bounded by count and distinct evidence question, read-only

bands.pass: Lightweight 0, Standard/Deep at most one scout + one verifier each with distinct question, read-only
bands.fail: Exceeds ceiling, duplicates question, or helper writes/chooses/addresses operator
